# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not disclose vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, pull requests,
discussions, or comments.

Report suspected vulnerabilities through the
[Adobe security reporting channel](https://helpx.adobe.com/security/alertus.html).
Identify the repository as `OneAdobe/project-ccua` and include the affected
toolkit version, a description of the impact, and a minimal reproduction using
synthetic data.

Do not submit customer code, production credentials, personal data, or other
confidential material. If additional information is needed, coordinate a secure
exchange with Adobe's security team.

## Versions and updates

Use the latest published toolkit release. Reports affecting older versions
should indicate whether the issue is reproducible in the latest release.
This policy does not promise a response time, remediation deadline, or
long-term support for any release.

## Safe use

The toolkit installs agent instructions and local tooling into a Commerce
project. Review agent actions, validate upgrades in a non-production environment,
and follow the project's deployment and data-protection controls.

The open-source license does not establish hosted-service terms, support
commitments, or a service-level agreement.
